ce_denom_rowfold.note: Toggle idea neural #3. The CE softmax denominator (loss L4, and L9 under smoothing) is routed as the (rows, 1, vocab) ones-GEMV, which choose_gemm_plan_tiles lands on PLAN_SPLIT_16_1X1: 1/16 of each block's threads own a cell, a rows x P workspace plane and a second fold launch. The switch computes the same gemm_oracle cell with one block per row, one thread per leaf (contract_leaf_size/contract_leaf_count), the tuned kernel's own per-step seam (_tuned_step) and the contract's 7.2 fold tree level by level in shared memory: execution plan only, same bits on NVIDIA, AMD and the host column (no host change). Leaf counts past CE_TPB threads keep the routed GEMM (same bits). Refused (comptime assert) together with MOJOLEARN_IDN_GEMM_LEAF=1|2 and Refused (comptime assert) together with MOJOLEARN_IDN_NEURAL_CHAINS: the neural GEMM profile spells a different chain. Also reached by samba-train-step through training/estimator.mojo identical_ce_loss_resident -> identical_ce_forward_into (_mojolearn_training). Interacts with neural_gemm_schedule (the GEMM route it bypasses for L4/L9), gemm_leaf=all256 (contract leaf, followed by both arms) and the other CE controls (ce_token_fold, ce_grad_fused) on the same loss step.

neural:lm-train-step.route: fit step: training/byte_lm.mojo:1488 identical_ce_forward_into -> training/checks/loss.mojo L4 (and L9 under smoothing): _ce_denom_rowfold_into | identical_gemm_into(expo, ones, n_rows, 1, vocab)

neural:samba-train-step.route: training step: _mojolearn_training samba_head_loss_host (training/samba_ops.mojo:432) -> training/estimator.mojo identical_ce_loss_resident -> identical_ce_forward_into -> loss.mojo L4/L9 as above
